description.p: Hut Hut is a local-first media player for your own music and video. Point it at your folders and it builds a clean, fast library — no accounts, no streaming, no network. Your files stay your files.

Organise everything in one place: a music collection, movies, shows, and loose videos, each with cover art pulled from the files themselves. Folder-bound playlists and collections track a folder on disk, so anything you drop into that folder shows up automatically — and a playlist bound to one folder never bleeds in tracks or art from a similarly named neighbour.
Built to stay out of your way and fully offline:

ul.li: Plays common audio (MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV, OGG, Opus, AAC, WMA) and video (MP4, MKV, WebM, AVI, MOV, M4V, WMV, M2TS) formats.
One library, four lenses: Collection (music), Movies, Shows, Videos.
Folder-bound playlists and collections that stay in sync as files come and go.
Cover art from embedded tags and folder images.
Resume where you left off, recently opened, and an up-next queue.
Completely offline: no network connections, no telemetry, no sign-in.
